game.name: Smash Court Tennis 3 (USA, Europe)
game.desc: With Smash Court Tennis 3 on Xbox 360, challenge the sixteen world players featured in the title: Roger Federer, Raphael Nadal, Gaël Monfils, Amélie Mauresmo... And find their playing style, strengths and weaknesses faithfully reproduced. Travel the world with your own player on fifteen real courts and championships. Discuss refereeing decisions and express your mood to wear down your opponent's concentration.
